methods.label: Set up and solve a simple equation
methods.explanation: Let the number be \(x\). Set up the equation \(3x-5=16\). Solving gives \(3x=21\), so \(x=7\). Check: \(3\times7-5=16\), which satisfies the conditions of the problem.
methods.levelReason: The model and its solution use elementary equation skills already introduced in Grade 5.
